title: Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc transformer linearization replaces the key-value cache of full attention, which grows linearly with generation length, with a fixed size state. This change reduces memory consumption but often hurts accuracy. In reasoning tasks, which require long generations, this effect is especially pronounced. In this work we introduce Turnout, a method that mitigates accuracy loss as a result of linearization, while maintaining its memory-reduction benefits. We apply post-hoc linearization to a pretrained full-attention model, training a linear path through distillation while leaving the original full-attention path unchanged. During response generation, the resulting hybrid model retains both paths and uses a learned policy to control when each layer switches from full to linear attention. translated_title: Turnout：面向高效推理的自适应注意力切换方法
translated_abstract: 事后transformer线性化用固定大小的状态取代全注意力中随生成长度线性增长的键值缓存。这一改变降低了内存消耗，但往往会损害准确率，而在需要长文本生成的推理任务中，这种影响尤为显著。在本工作中，我们提出了Turnout，一种能够在保持线性化内存缩减优势的同时缓解其准确率损失的方法。我们将事后线性化应用于预训练的全注意力模型，通过蒸馏训练出一条线性路径，同时保持原有的全注意力路径不变。在响应生成过程中，所得的混合模型同时保留两条路径，并利用一个学习到的策略来控制每一层何时从全注意力切换到线性注意力。该策略通过强化学习进行训练，奖励函数在答案正确性与内存使用之间取得平衡。对我们方法的实证评估表明……
tldr: 提出Turnout方法，在预训练全注意力模型中通过蒸馏保留线性注意力路径，并利用强化学习训练的自适应策略在每一层动态切换全注意力与线性注意力，从而在大幅降低内存消耗的同时保持长文本推理任务的准确率。
en_tdlr: Turnout uses a reinforcement-learned policy to adaptively switch each layer between full and linear attention, mitigating the accuracy loss of post-hoc linearization while retaining its memory savings for efficient long-form reasoning.
